text:
alex_fin: Hey team - just got flagged by support. Customer BlueSky Labs downgraded mid-cycle (Pro -> Starter) on 2025-11-03 but was invoiced for the full month. They have a PO (PO-9988) on file and are EU (IE). They need a partial credit note that includes VAT reverse-charge handling. When I try to create the credit note via the billing API it fails with a 500. Full details below.

sophie-c: Ack. Can you paste the invoice id and the exact API call + error? Also did the original charge go to card or via PO?

alex_fin: Invoice is inv_2025_0042, charge state: paid (card on file), but support says the customer also submitted a PO and expects a credit note that references the PO for their accounting. API call I'm hitting: 

```
POST /api/v1/credit_notes
{
  "invoice_id": "inv_2025_0042",
  "amount_cents": 37250,
  "currency": "EUR",
  "reason": "prorated downgrade 2025-11",
  "po_number": "PO-9988"
}
```

Response: 500 Internal Server Error 
{"error":"Missing tax rate for EU reverse charge: IE"}

billing-bot: [auto] credit_note.create failed for invoice inv_2025_0042 - error_code=tax_rate_lookup_failed

maya_re: Looks like our tax_rates table doesn't have the IE reverse-charge code (we started shipping RC codes as ISO+RC in 2025-10). Quick repro I did: replicate customer profile with country=IE, set invoice as prorated amount and call /api/v1/credit_notes -> 500.

maya_re: Short-term options: (1) create manual ledger credit and mark invoice adjusted, then issue customer-facing credit note PDF manually; (2) create a temporary tax_rate row with key "IE-RC" and run the API call again (needs DB write and QA).

raj_ops: For option 1 I can run a safe ledger reversal, but need confirmation on GL codes and whether we should attach PO metadata to the credit note PDF. Finance, do you require the PO printed on the credit note?

alex_fin: Yes, customer insisted PO on the credit note. It must reference PO-9988. Also VAT must be 0% with a note: "Reverse charge - customer liable for VAT (IE)".

emma_support: Customer-facing: we should tell them we're issuing a partial credit and will attach PO on the credit note. ETA? Also they reported a declined attempt earlier (card declined) but later charged - not sure if that affects refund routing.

sophie-c: Steps I recommend: (A) maya, can you test creating a temporary tax_rate "IE-RC" in staging and confirm the API path works and the PDF generator includes PO metadata? (B) If green, raj, please run a controlled DB write in prod to add the tax_rate (with audit) and re-run credit note creation for inv_2025_0042. (C) If we can't risk DB write, do the manual ledger credit + manually generate PDF containing PO and reverse-charge text.

maya_re: On it - will test in staging and paste logs. Repro commands I ran: 
```
curl -X POST https://billing.staging.internal/api/v1/credit_notes \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer stg-..." \
  -d '{"invoice_id":"inv_2025_0042","amount_cents":37250,"currency":"EUR","reason":"prorate downgrade","po_number":"PO-9988"}'
```
Got 500 with same payload. After inserting tax_rate key "IE-RC" with rate 0 and notes "Reverse charge", the call returns 201 and the generated credit note JSON contains: `tax_handling":"reverse_charge","po_number":"PO-9988"`. PDF generator populates PO.

alex_fin: Good find. Can you capture DB migration snippet we should run? Also check whether adding IE-RC will have any downstream impact on existing invoices.

maya_re: Migration is a single insert into tax_rates. I'll draft a one-off migration with explicit id, created_by and audit_reason. It only affects credit note creation path. Will run a quick runbook and link here in 30m.

emma_support: Meanwhile I'll message BlueSky saying we have a plan, target issue resolution EOD, offer interim statement showing the credit amount for their AP team.

sophie-c: Finance: please confirm GL codes for manual ledger reversal if we go fallback route. If we do DB write we need a 2-person approval (maya + raj) and a post-change verification in staging and prod.

raj_ops: I can approve and run the write once maya posts runbook. Also will add a transient feature flag to allow rollback of the new tax key.

alex_fin: Thanks all. Action items: maya to post runbook + staging logs, raj to prep prod migration + rollback flag, finance to confirm GL codes for manual credit if needed, emma to update customer. I'll follow up when we have prod runbook. :thumbsup:
